lines.t: Most Black Friday deals… aren't actually deals.
lines.title: FAKE *DEALS?*

lines.t: The UK consumer group Which? tracked Black Friday prices for months before and after the sale.
lines.title: THEY TRACKED *THE PRICES*

lines.t: In their twenty twenty-three study, ninety-two percent of deals were the same price, or cheaper, at other times of the year.
lines.title: SAME PRICE OR *CHEAPER* LATER

lines.t: And only about two percent were actually at their lowest price on Black Friday itself.
lines.title: CHEAPEST ON *BLACK FRIDAY*

lines.t: So before you buy, check the price history. Free trackers like Keepa or CamelCamelCamel show you if that deal is real.
lines.title: BEFORE YOU *BUY*

lines.t: Save this for Friday. And follow so you don't get played.
lines.title: SAVE THIS FOR *FRIDAY*
